# D7 — Hafte Kasif Tournament Tracker

> Web app for tracking bi-weekly Hafte Kasif (Bisheori) card game tournaments among a group of friends in Denmark.

## What it does

D7 is a private tournament tracker for the Hafte Kasif card game. It manages player profiles, tournament sessions, scoring rounds, and rankings. The app is mobile-first, supports dark mode, and is used between rounds at the table.

## Key features

- Tournament management with bi-weekly session tracking
- Player profiles with avatars and cumulative stats
- Event-sourced scoring with full history
- Real-time ranking tables
- Mobile-first UI for quick score entry
- Dark mode support

## Architecture

- Language: TypeScript
- Frontend: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Netlify Functions (Node.js serverless)
- Database: PostgreSQL (Neon)
- Deployment: Netlify (app) + GitHub Pages (public results)
- Testing: Vitest (unit + integration)

## Repository
